A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VIBE research and contain readable text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices. The retained material and v3's additions support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original user studies with 243 participants across three datasets, summary-scoring experiments, backbone comparisons, and correlation analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains the original user-study and experimental results, including the appendix analyses, and revises the LearningPaper24 Pareto results.

M1.justification: The masking procedures, conditional-probability grounding and utility scores, and weighted summary-selection rule in Equations (3)–(5) remain unchanged. The added temperature statement documents candidate generation without establishing a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate LearningPaper24, LongVideoBench, and SUTD-TrafficQA with the same paper-area classification and video question-answering tasks. No dataset, population, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The Video Only and Naive comparisons, OpenReview TL;DR and abstract comparators, and treatment of CoT remain unchanged. The backbone comparison retains Qwen-2.5-72B-AWQ, InternVL2.5-8B-MPO, and InternVL3-38B.

E3.justification: The participant counts, ten-stimulus studies, five candidate summaries, evaluation metrics, and Appendix D sampling and masking settings are retained. The new disclosure that candidates use various temperatures does not establish a change to an earlier setting.

E4.justification: The existing backbone-robustness analysis receives revised Qwen evidence in Figure 6(a). Its plot previously duplicated the InternVL2.5 panel but is distinct in v3. The other backbone results, qualitative example, and correlation analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain mean and standard-deviation reporting, standard-error displays, independent t-tests, Cohen's d, and Spearman correlations. No new run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or statistical procedures are disclosed.

E6.justification: LearningPaper24's Pareto points and reference-summary score positions change in Figure 3(c), repeated in the Qwen panel of Figure 6(a). These are revised reported scores, not an established performance improvement. Table 1 and the human-study results in Figures 4 and 9 remain unchanged; the traffic plot is only rescaled.

T1.justification: New Appendix I derives the grounding-score approximation through probability factorization and cancellation under an independence assumption. v2 states the approximation and its condition near Equation (3) but lacks this derivation. The underlying score definitions remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about annotation-free, task-aware summary selection and improved human performance. Adding 'Annotation-Free' to the title restates an existing claim.

C2.justification: The interpretations of the grounding–utility trade-off, task-label requirements, benefits for longer videos, and masking and model biases remain unchanged. The new derivation formalizes the existing independence assumption without establishing its practical validity.

D1.justification: v3 discloses generation with various temperatures and adds Appendix H specifying four RTX 6000 Ada GPUs, the vLLM backend, and CPU details. It adds a project-site link while retaining the existing code and dataset links, with the dataset link relocated to the first page.

R1.justification: The same 48 references and substantive related-work positioning are retained. Citation formatting and the conference footer change without revising the relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: v3 expands the title, corrects a participant-text typo, standardizes cross-references, adds acknowledgements, and appends two short sections. The main narrative and organization are otherwise retained.

P2.justification: Figures 3 and 6 change grounding/utility axis labels and selected scales. Table 5 moves beside the participant discussion, appendix content reflows, and references become colored links. The remaining figures and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves transparency through hardware/backend and temperature disclosures, an explicit conditional derivation, and a distinct Qwen plot replacing the duplicate in v2. The human-study evidence is unchanged. The derivation still assumes masking-induced independence, and revised plot notation remains inconsistent with Section 4, limiting the overall gain.
